name: Jackrabbit
summary: Hands on the footbar, feet against the shoulder rests, heels lifted. The legs push the carriage out to a plank, then the knees bend in under the body with a rounded back before stretching out again.
steps: Hands on the footbar, feet against the shoulder rests with the heels lifted; start with the knees bent and the back rounded.
Breathe in to straighten the legs and send the carriage back to a long plank.
Breathe out to bend the knees in under the hips, rounding the back, without letting the shoulders drift behind the hands.

layers.title: Knees stay on the carriage
layers.text: Knee Stretches shape; learn the pattern.

layers.title: Knees hover
layers.text: Knees a few centimetres up the whole time.

layers.title: Add a pike
layers.text: From the plank, lift the hips before bending in.

cautions.note: Fists or forearms on the box.
Smaller range; keep the shoulders over the hands.

cues:
Shoulders stay over the wrists.
Round from the tail, not the upper back only.
The carriage comes home quietly.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Knee Stretches instead
variations.note: Same pattern with the knees down.
